summary: All 24 files in the HexSignDet library contain substantial formal mathematical content. Every file defines structures, functions, and proves theorems related to the sign determination algorithm (Sturm/BKR method), including: coefficient serialization and finite-reader roundtrip theorems (Codec/), common product construction and verification (CommonProduct), root comparison via Thom encoding (Compare, Complete, Thom, ThomOrder), finite moment systems and linear algebra (Matrix, Support, Counts), DAG-based proof certificates with validation and replay (Dag, DagReplay, DagSelectedSigns), descriptor construction and validation (Descriptor), support induction and observation interpretation (Induction), query handling and selected-sign extraction (QueryHandle, QueryReduction, SelectedSigns), reduction chains with positive pseudo-division (Reduction), joint re-encoding with old-root constraints (Reencode), recursive BKR replay trees (Replay), root enumeration from checked tables (RootList), and sparse sign tables (Table). All declarations are kernel-checked definitions, theorems, instances, or structures — no file is a pure import aggregator, documentation-only, or has content exactly duplicated elsewhere.
